messages.content: "ramesh ra sita pokhara gae. ramesh le dunga chalayo, sita le phewa tal ko photo khichi." photo kasle khichi?
photo sita le khichi.
messages.steps: passage ma 'sita le phewa tal ko photo khichi' bhaneko chha.

messages.content: yo padha: "bhojpur ko euta school ma 120 bidyarthi chhan. tinmadhye 70 keti ra baki keta." keta kati jana?
keta 50 jana chhan.
"aaja bihana pani paryo, tara diuso ghaam laagyo. beluka hawa chalyo." diuso mausam kasto thiyo?
diuso ghaam laageko thiyo.
messages.steps: passage anusar bihana pani, diuso ghaam, beluka hawa.

messages.content: "kamala ko pasal ma 3 kisim ko chiya painchha: kalo chiya, dudh chiya ra masala chiya. sabai bhanda mahango masala chiya ho." sabai bhanda mahango kun?
sabai bhanda mahango masala chiya ho.
"hari 8 baje uthyo, 9 baje office gayo ra 5 baje ghar farkiyo." hari kati baje office gayo?
hari 9 baje office gayo.
"hari 8 baje uthyo, 9 baje office gayo ra 5 baje ghar farkiyo." hari ghar bata kati ghanta bahira rahyo?
hari 8 ghanta ghar bahira rahyo.
messages.steps: 9 baje gayo, 5 baje (17 baje) farkiyo. 17 - 9 = 8 ghanta.

messages.content: passage: "nisha ko kukur ko naam tommy ho. tommy lai masu man parchha tara dudh man pardaina." tommy lai dudh man parchha?
haina, tommy lai dudh man pardaina. usle masu man paraunchha.
"gita ko ghar dharan ma chha. usko sathi binita itahari ma basin." binita kaha basin?
binita itahari ma basin.
"bus kathmandu bata bihana 6 baje chhutyo ra 7 ghanta pachhi pokhara pugyo." bus kati baje pokhara pugyo?
bus diuso 1 baje pokhara pugyo.
messages.steps: 6 baje + 7 ghanta = 13 baje, arthat diuso 1 baje.

messages.content: "suman le 4 ota kapi ra 2 ota kalam kinyo. euta kapi 60 rupiya ra euta kalam 25 rupiya." suman le jamma kati tiryo?
suman le jamma 290 rupiya tiryo.
"prakash cricket khelchha, uska bhai football. dubai jana sanibar khelchhan." prakash ko bhai k khelchha?
prakash ko bhai football khelchha.
"anju doctor ho, uski didi teacher ra uska buba kisan." anju ki didi ko kaam k ho?
anju ki didi teacher hun.
"rina le 3 ota syau ra 5 ota suntala lyai. usle 2 ota syau bhai lai dii." rina sanga kati syau baki chha?
rina sanga 1 ota syau baki chha.
messages.steps: syau 3 thiyo, 2 diyo. 3 - 2 = 1. suntala ko kura yo prashna ma chahindaina.

messages.content: read this: "The train left at 4 pm and arrived 3 hours later." When did it arrive?
It arrived at 7 pm.
"bikram sabai bhanda aglo chha, tara dipesh bikram bhanda chhito daudinchha." sabai bhanda aglo ko?
sabai bhanda aglo bikram ho. dipesh chai chhito daudinchha, aglo haina.
"mero hajurama 75 barsha ki hunuhunchha ra hajurba unibhanda 5 barsha jetho." hajurba kati barsha ko?
hajurba 80 barsha ko hunuhunchha.
"sagar ko kaksha ma 30 jana chhan. aaja 4 jana anupasthit thiye." aaja kati jana upasthit?
aaja 26 jana upasthit thiye.
yo kura padhera bhana: "laxmi le bihana dudh kinin, diuso tarkari ra beluka chamal." laxmi le tarkari kahile kinin?
laxmi le tarkari diuso kinin.
"pasang solukhumbu ko ho. u sherpa bhasa ra nepali dubai bolchha." pasang kun kun bhasa bolchha?
pasang sherpa bhasa ra nepali dubai bolchha.
"aaja school ma kheladi pratiyogita bhayo. rato team le 3 goal garyo, nilo team le 5." kun team jityo?
nilo team jityo, 5 - 3 le.
"ram ghar gayo tara shyam pustakalaya mai basyo." ke shyam ghar gayo?
haina, shyam ghar gaena. u pustakalaya mai basyo. ghar ta ram gayo.
"kiran ko jacket nilo ho ra usko jutta kalo." kiran ko jutta kun rang ko?
kiran ko jutta kalo rang ko ho.
passage: "euta tokari ma 12 anda thiyo. 3 ota phutyo. aama le baki anda ko adha pakaunubhayo." kati anda pakaiyo?
9 ota anda ko adha 4.5 hunchha, tara anda adha garna mildaina. tyasaile lagbhag 4 ya 5 ota pakaiyo hola; passage le thik sankhya dinna.
"sunita ko janmadin falgun 12 gate ho ra usko bhai ko chaitra 3 gate." kasko janmadin pahile aauchha (baishakh bata ganda)?
sunita ko janmadin pahile aauchha, kinaki falgun chaitra bhanda agadi aauchha.
"dinesh le 5000 rupiya kamayo ra tesko 40 percent bachayo." dinesh le kati bachayo?
dinesh le 2000 rupiya bachayo.
"chautari muni 3 jana budhabudhi basera kura gardai thiye. euta keto paani bokera aayo." chautari muni kati jana basira thiye?
chautari muni 3 jana budhabudhi basira thiye. pani boknne keto pachhi aayeko ho.
"Asha had 12 balloons and 5 flew away." How many balloons does Asha have now?
Asha has 7 balloons now.
yo vakya ma kati jana manchhe chhan? "aama, buba ra didi bazaar gaunubhayo."
vakya ma 3 jana chhan: aama, buba ra didi.
"sujan le kitab padhyo, ani khana khayo, ani sutyo." sujan le sabai bhanda pahile k garyo?
sujan le sabai bhanda pahile kitab padhyo.
"mohan ko ghar bata school 2 km ra school bata bazaar 3 km chha." mohan ghar bata school hudai bazaar jada kati km hidchha?
mohan jamma 5 km hidchha.
